description: Retrieve full details of an existing Slideshow Run by runId, including complete slide pages, bound template IDs, slot contents, brand theme snapshot, current revision number, and studio review URL. Call before update_slideshow_run to inspect current slide contents and capture baseRevision for concurrency locking. Alternatives: Use list_slideshow_runs to discover runIds. Read-only query scoped to authenticated workspace owner.

runId.description: The unique Slideshow Run identifier to retrieve.

name: get_slideshow_run
title: Get slideshow run
